parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the main teachings from Hadith 1.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain the teachings of the Prophet (pbuh) on how Muslims could avoid arrogance. You
must refer to Qurʾan 31.18–19 and any other verse or Hadith that you have studied.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘The best way Muslims can show sincerity is by not talking about their own good deeds.’ Do
you agree? 
EITHER

text: Read the following text passages, then answer the questions which follow.
͑Umar ibn al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
‘Messenger of Allah ( ) said, “The deeds are considered by the intentions, and a person will
get the reward according to his intention. So, whoever emigrated for Allah and His Messenger,
his emigration will be for Allah and His Messenger; and whoever emigrated for worldly benefits
or for a woman to marry, his emigration would be for what he emigrated for.”’ [Al-Bukhari and
And swell not thy cheek (for pride) at men, nor walk in insolence through the earth; for Allah
loveth not any arrogant boaster. And be moderate in thy pace, and lower thy voice; for the
harshest of sounds without doubt is the braying of the ass.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how Muslims can increase God-consciousness (taqwa) through their worship.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘The main purpose of the statement of faith (shahadah) is to purify the Muslim.’ Discuss with
reference to different points of view. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how Eid prayer differs from the five daily prayers.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘The Eid prayer is the only way of including everyone in the Eid festivals.’ Discuss with
reference to different points of view.
